facts.content: User is Alex Vance, a senior distributed systems architect.

Concise, technically dense communication style with zero conversational filler.

Security invariant: Code owns authority; AI proposals cannot write state without validation.
Persona and goal memory candidates require explicit user confirmation in the UI.
Rate cap is enforced at maximum 5 writes per conversation turn.
